title: ajuga chamaepitys subsp. mesogitana
intro: Ajuga chamaepitys subsp. mesogitana, commonly known as a type of bugleweed or mountain bugle, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality, as well as its therapeutic actions like sedation and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Ajuga chamaepitys subsp. mesogitana include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
